title: The closure of a generated subsystem is the subsystem itself
author: Silvia Barbina; Enrique Casanovas
work: The elementary theory of free Steiner triple systems
difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled lemma at source lines 358-360: for an HF-ordering of M, a subset A and the assumption that A equals its closure, the closure of the subsystem generated by A is that subsystem. The proof (source lines 361-363) replaces the generated subsystem by its presentation as a union of finite stages, reduces the claim to an induction on the stage, and the whole content of the induction step is the observation that a new element is a product of two elements of the previous union, so that the closure of that union already contains it because the closure is closed under forming blocks from elements already present. The statement records only the equality.

proof_spans.label: the complete author proof of the labelled lemma, retained line for line
